models.title: Signal
models.statement: Visible output does not by itself establish intrinsic continuity.

practical.title: What is visible?
practical.body: Observe output without presuming internal cause.

engineering.title: Separate measurement channels
engineering.body: Keep observed output distinct from constitutive state.

evidence.title: Fixture only
evidence.body: This record tests runtime reuse, not scientific validity.

models.title: Return With Memory
models.statement: A lawful return restores the exact prior state rather than approximating a reset.

practical.title: Go back without losing place
practical.body: Return restores the prior view and selection.

engineering.title: Token-bound restoration
engineering.body: The snapshot is verified before restoration.

evidence.title: Deterministic test only
evidence.body: The fixture can verify state integrity without validating a scientific construct.
